capabilities: Convert selected text or the whole document between Simplified and Traditional Chinese
Toggle conversion direction with a ribbon icon that shows the current state
Run conversion commands from the command palette
extras: The README is bilingual (English and Chinese) and includes a Demo section, but the demo content itself is not present in the text.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to convert Chinese text between its Simplified and Traditional forms.
summary: Text converter that switches selected text or whole notes between Simplified and Traditional Chinese via a ribbon icon or commands.
